in_tamil.name: Sheetalaprasad
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God's grace, divine gift
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sheetalaprasad ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Sheetala refers to coolness and Prasad means grace or divine gift. This name signifies the blessings and grace of God.

in_telugu.name: Sheetalaprasad
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God's grace, divine gift
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sheetalaprasad ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Sheetala refers to coolness and Prasad means grace or divine gift. This name signifies the blessings and grace of God.

in_marathi.name: Sheetalaprasad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's grace, divine gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sheetalaprasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sheetala refers to coolness and Prasad means grace or divine gift. This name signifies the blessings and grace of God.

in_bengali.name: Sheetalaprasad
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's grace, divine gift
